lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible on the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region, arranged in approximately four to five horizontal rows with relatively uniform inter-spot spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like grid where the spots serve as nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light-colored dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral border.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense population of significantly smaller, high-frequency luminance points is clustered on the dorsal and lateral surfaces of the head, anterior to the first gill slit.
